Rada said her request is technical evaluation of contradictory information about a reportedly deactivated heating branch continuing to heat a property without regular consumption records; she said she does not request entry to ducts or procurement of central records
Rada invited Bartolomeu to hear details, explicitly offering him the possibility to refuse and let her find another contact
Bartolomeu asked Rada for the details of her request
Rada displayed a folded paper with two handwritten lines and no stamp/signature while remaining outside the workshop

Rada claimed a secondary branch in Cidade Velha was documented as isolated on both supply and return, while someone later reported warm radiators in a building supposedly served by it, with no recorded consumption
Rada disclaimed possession of the original closure order or manoeuvre number, and asked what Bartolomeu would first suspect if this were his work order
